briefdescription.para: Validates error code against Phase 1 taxonomy.

detaileddescription.para:
code
Code to validate
true if code is a known Phase 1 error code
Use for defensive programming; unknown codes should be treated as GENERIC_ERROR and logged for debugging.

simplesect.title: Invariant 1: Error Code Stability
simplesect.para: Once a code is assigned in Phase 1, its numeric value MUST NOT change. This ensures cross-version log compatibility and metrics aggregation.

simplesect.title: Invariant 2: Category Stability
simplesect.para: Error category (DENIAL/FALLBACK/REASONING_CONFLICT) MUST NOT change for existing codes. Adding new codes in a different category requires a new code; reassigning an old code is forbidden.

simplesect.title: Invariant 3: Determinism
simplesect.para: Error classification (getErrorCategory, isRecoverableFallback, etc.) MUST produce identical results on any platform. No runtime variation.

simplesect.title: Invariant 4: Completeness
simplesect.para: Every error code returned by graph module functions MUST be classified in this taxonomy. Unclassified errors MUST be mapped to GENERIC_ERROR.

simplesect.title: Invariant 5: Thread Safety
simplesect.para: All error classification functions are thread-safe and lock-free. Error context construction is thread-safe (value semantics).
